title: New widget: Breadcrumb
body:
A few weeks ago, the [breadcrumb](https://community.algolia.com/react-instantsearch/storybook/?selectedKind=Breadcrumb\&selectedStory=default\&full=0\&down=1\&left=1\&panelRight=1\&downPanel=storybooks%2Fstorybook-addon-knobs) was added to the React Instant Search widgets, it helps the user to quickly get where the current page is in relation to the website’s hierarchy. We could also add it to InstantSearch.js library! (This has been discussed a few months ago, see #951)
